source_record.description:
We're looking for

We are looking for you as a Working Student Analytics Engineering (f/m/x) to join one of our various departments
and help us at thermondo make an important contribution to climate neutrality. With your interest
in renewable energy and your identification with our values — Our word counts, Better every day,
and Stronger together — you can create real added value for all of us


If you enjoy this

  • Answering Data-related questions from business stakeholders across all departments
  • Building new dashboards and improving existing dashboards in Looker
  • Conducting ad hoc analyses and translating data requests into clear results
  • Monitoring data quality and working closely with our Analytics Engineers
  • Documenting KPIs and data sources, and contributing to our data dictionary
  • Writing basic SQL queries for data exploration and analysis


And recognise yourself here

  • You are enrolled in a data-related or analytical degree programme, such as Data Science, Business Informatics, Statistics, Economics or a comparable field, with at least two semesters remaining.
  • SQL basics: You understand basic syntax, filtering, JOINs and aggregations.
  • BI experience: You have worked with a BI or reporting tool such as Looker, Tableau or Power BI and can explain what you built with it.
  • Data understanding: You can prepare analysis results clearly and explain them to non-technical stakeholders.
  • AI tools: You use tools such as Gemini or Claude in a practical way to support analysis, research or problem-solving.
  • Independent work: You have initial practical experience with smaller data-related tasks and can structure your work with limited guidance.
  • Languages: You speak German at least at B1 level and English at C1 level.


What we have to offer

  • A meaningful purpose — through your work, you make an important contribution to
  • making homes climate-neutral
  •  Professional development opportunities with experienced mentors
  • Interaction with other working students in an open working environment
  • A collaborative team with diverse backgrounds
  • A fantastic culture within the team and beyond
  • A modern office in the heart of Berlin
  • The option to bring your dog to work one day per week
  • Working in a hybrid model
  • The option to lease a company bike
  • The option to use a membership at Urban Sports Club
  • Corporate benefits with more than 100 partners


About us

Every application is welcome at thermondo — regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion, beliefs, disability, age, sexual orientation, or identity. We believe that every person is valuable and deserves a fair chance.

No home is like another, but for each of us, home is where we belong. It represents what defines
us and what matters to us. It has always been the place where we want to feel safe, secure, and undisturbed.

But we believe that our homes will stand for more in the future — namely, for the generations that come after us. We believe our homes can do more. They can be electrified, intelligent, efficient, independent, and climate-neutral. We believe climate-neutral living should be accessible, affordable, and easy for everyone. With every heat pump installed outside a home, every photovoltaic system installed on a roof, and every wallbox installed in a garage, we contribute to climate-neutral living.

We do not just believe in climate-neutral living — we make it possible. For millions of homes.Together. Every day. One home at a time


Your application process

  • Your CV is reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team
  • An initial introductory conversation with your Talent Acquisition Manager, Alex
  • If we have a suitable open position, we will contact you again about the next steps
  • If there is currently no suitable position available, you will become part of the thermondo
  • talent pool for future opportunities
